purpose: One-time reviewed import of the battery parallel-cluster limit (stacks_parallel_max) for the products whose own associated documents state it; never a runtime product source.

source.quote: The BAT-C Series 208.9kWh Commercial & Industrial Battery System supports a maximum of 4 battery cabinet clusters in parallel.
source.basis: GoodWe BAT-C 208.9-261.2 kWh user manual (EN) p.53 limits the BAT-C 208.9 kWh system to four parallel cabinet clusters.

source.quote: The energy storage system supports master-slave parallel connection. The system does not support connection to a PV inverter, and can support up to 8 units in parallel.
source.basis: GoodWe ESA 261 kWh user manual (EN V1.6) p.46 limits master-slave parallel connection to eight units.
Pylontech OPTIM US L260-OMNI datasheet p.2 prints Max.parallel No. 6.

unbound.BAT-S 35.8-56.3 kWh (six parallel units): GoodWe ET 50-100 kW user manual (EN V1.3) p.11 states six parallel units, but no BAT-S product exists in the current 85-product engineering feed, so no product can carry the figure.
unbound.SAJ B2/BU2 (five modules): Already covered by modules_per_stack_max on 1832/2067-2070/2090; the SAJ datasheet limit is modules per system, not parallel clusters.
unbound.SAJ HS3 (eight batteries per inverter): Already covered by modules_per_stack_max = 8 on 2093; the limit is batteries per inverter.
unbound.SAJ CB2 x CH2 (four CB2 per CH2): The CB2 manuals (user manual p.8) limit four CB2 systems per CH2 inverter. That is systems per inverter, which no maintained figure expresses; recording it as stacks_parallel_max would misstate it.
unbound.GoodWe BAT-C 92.1/102.4/112.6 (four per: The ET 50-100 kW manual (EN V1.3) p.12 states four parallel units. Product 1955 (GW112.6-BAT-AC-G10) already carries stacks_parallel_max = 4 from the BAT-C 60-112 datasheet p.1.
unbound.GoodWe ET 50-100 kW (15 inverters in par: ET 50-100 kW manual (EN V1.3) p.11 states a maximum of 15 inverters in parallel. compatibility.schema.json documents max_units as "the most inverters one controller coordinates", so storing a system limit there would mislabel it; it stays a documented gap.
unbound.GoodWe Lynx D G2 G21 variants (6521/6522: The 12-unit parallel statement lives in the Lynx D G2 datasheet (EU-EN V1.1), which is associated with 3611/3612/6519/6520 only. 6521/6522 carry the IEC 62619 certificate, which prints no parallel limit, so no figure is written for them.
unbound.GoodWe BAT-C 261.2 kWh: The BAT-C 208.9-261.2 manual limits the 208.9 kWh product explicitly; it prints no separate cluster limit for the 261.2 kWh model.
